output.reason: The cited span for para 261(2)(ii) says a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges only on loans with sanctioned amount/limit up to ₹50 lakh. Since the loan in question is ₹60 lakh, it falls outside that threshold, so the specific no-charge rule does not apply. The residual clause span also indicates that cases outside para 261(1) and (2) are governed by the UCB’s approved policy.
